title: Signal: SHA-1 use via hashlib.sha1 (python) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on the hashlib.sha1 call in python code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: matches any hashlib.sha1 call regardless of purpose. Name-selected SHA-1 and other weak algorithms are separate rules.
fpNotes: Git object ids, legacy protocol interop, and checksums are the common false positives.
